llo.notes: Direct transfer to a 100 km perilune, then a braking burn into a circular 100 km orbit (CR3BP).

flyby.notes: Free return: after leaving Earth orbit, the Moon's gravity bends the path back to Earth with no more burns (CR3BP).

dro.notes: Direct transfer: one burn leaving Earth orbit, one burn matching the target orbit (CR3BP).
